outcome: duration of third stage of labour
cohort: Pregnant women aged 18-40 years with any parity, gestation >36 weeks, and haemoglobin >7.0gm who underwent spontaneous vaginal delivery.
finding: Placental cord blood drainage significantly reduced postpartum blood loss and the duration of the third stage of labour in normal vaginal birth patients.
mod_finding: The study found a significant reduction in postpartum blood loss and third stage duration specifically in normal vaginal birth patients when placental cord blood drainage was used.
followup_time: Immediate postpartum (until cessation of cord blood flow)
